Vaccines are an essential tool to keeping children and adults safe and healthy.   There are currently at least two confirmed measles outbreaks in the United States — in West Texas and New Mexico.    In the last 24 hours in Texas, a child died…

The Health Subcommittee hearing took a bold step in exposing the wasteful practices of Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs) like CVS Health, Cigna, and UnitedHealth. These giants control 80% of the market, manipulating drug prices and squeezing out independent pharmacies, leading to closures. 

The Pharmacy Benefit Manager Reform Act aims to end spread pricing and demand transparency. Despite PBMs spending $47M to block reforms, the push for accountability is unstoppable. 

Congress must prioritize PBM accountability to protect patients and pharmacies from systemic price manipulation.
